metadata.title: The Well-Tempered clAIvier
metadata.subtitle: Prelude VI in D minor
metadata.composer: Claude / Sam (after J. S. Bach, Toccata BWV 565 and Prelude BWV 851)
metadata.tempo_text: Toccata con recitativo. Adagio - Allegro - Recitativo - Presto

markers.label: Toccata: after BWV 565 (A-G-A, G F E D C# D, in octaves)
two octaves lower, onto the low D
diminished seventh rolled up over the D, resolved to D minor
Allegro: running triplets (after BWV 851) over a tonic pedal
the bass walks the lament ground: D, C#
Dm - cut off by a diminished seventh (fermata)
Recitativo I: the fugue subject declaimed (A Bb B C ...)
... D, and the leap to A, over F: the music turns to F major
Recitativo II: the subject at the E level, in the bass (E F F# G ...)
... A, and the leap to E: A major over its fifth
Presto: diminished-seventh cascade, falling onto the A
the BWV 565 figure again, stopping on C#
